main.description: A node with what every screen draws around it: its children of either kind, the way down to it, and what the caller may do here. One call where the interim makes several. Give `path` or `id`, not both. Serves only what the caller may read.

path.description: The slugs from the root, slash-joined; empty segments are ignored.

node.description: A contextView or a documentView, told apart by an added `node` field.

children.description: Live children the caller may read, contexts and documents in one list, by `idx` and then age.

crumbs.description: A crumb per path segment, the node's own last.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No live node is there, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Neither `path` nor `id` was given, or both were.

childView.description: A child as a folder view and the drawer need it: the same fields whichever table it lives in, and no content.

mutable.description: Always false for a context, which is locked from the day it is made.

data.description: A file's id and type, a cover image: what a row needs to draw itself.

child_count.description: Live children, so the drawer offers to expand only what has some.

crumbView.description: One segment of the way down. Where the caller may not read the node a segment names, only `slug` and `path` are present: they hold the slug already, in the URL, and are told nothing more.

viewerView.description: What the caller may do here. All false for a signed-out reader.

is_context_owner.description: They hold the owner role in its context.

can_vote.description: They hold voting rights in its context.
